message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo, fought on **June 18, 1815**, resulted in roughly **23,000 total casualties**—including killed, wounded, and missing—across all sides. In more detail:

| Side | Approximate casualties |
|------|------------------------|
| Allied (British, Dutch, Belgian, Prussian) | ~8,000 killed & wounded |
| French | ~12,000 killed & wounded |
| Total | ~23,000 |

These figures are estimates based on contemporary reports and later historical analyses.
